title: Relative affineness criterion via first cohomology of ideal sheaves: a quasi-compact morphism f : X -> Y with X, Y quasi-separated is affine as soon as R^1f_*I vanishes for every quasi-coherent sheaf of ideals on X.
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter coherent.tex (Cohomology of Schemes)
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28), file coherent.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The relative argument is fully in the span: test affineness on an affine open V of Y; the base change U -> X of the quasi-compact immersion V -> Y is quasi-compact (permanence plus base-change lemmas), which is exactly what the ideal-extension lemma needs to extend any quasi-coherent ideal on U to X; locality of R^1f_* on the target gives R^1(U -> V)_*I = 0; Leray turns H^1(U, I) into H^1(V, (U -> V)_*I), the pushforward is quasi-coherent by the pushforward lemma, and the affine vanishing lemma kills it; the chapter's absolute criterion lemma-quasi-compact-h1-zero-covering (card L16365) concludes U affine.
